light.best.quote: Spider plant prefers medium light levels yet can tolerate deep shade.

light.min.quote: Spider plant prefers medium light levels yet can tolerate deep shade.

light.directSun.quote: It is intolerant of direct sunlight.

temperature.idealC.quote: Temperatures between 65 °F and 75°F during the day and 50 °F to 55 °F at night are ideal.

watering.growing.quote: Spider plants should be allowed to dry out briefly between waterings.
It grows best in moist soil

tips.ja: 水道水の塩素やフッ素で葉先が枯れることがある。
tips.quote: Avoid watering with tap water as the chlorine and fluorides can cause leaf tip burn.

tips.ja: 肥料を与えすぎると子株がつきにくくなる。
tips.quote: Do not over-fertilize, as this decreases plantlet formation.

tips.ja: 子株は、1日の明るい時間が12時間未満の日が3週間以上続くとつく（夜に照明を当てない）。
tips.quote: less than 12 hours of light a day

tips.ja: 葉先が茶色く枯れるのは、肥料のやりすぎ・塩類の多い水・湿度不足・乾かしすぎ。
tips.quote: Leaf tip burn is caused by too much fertilizer or water that is high in soluble salts. Low humidity and excessively dry soil may also cause brown leaf tips.

tips.ja: 冬は窓から少し離して、すきま風を避ける。
tips.quote: Move spider plants a few feet from windows to protect them from drafts during the winter.
